name: The works of Jože Plečnik in Ljubljana – Human Centred Urban Design
description: In Ljubljana, Slovenia, architect Jože Plečnik spent the years between the world wars reshaping the city into a capital for the Slovenian people. His riverside promenades, graceful bridges, covered market, and the National and University Library fit gently among older streets. Walking along the Ljubljanica, you pass his work at human scale, from planted embankments to quiet cemetery gardens.
